tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.lede: Switch between related panels without leaving the page. Arrow keys move between tabs; the panel follows.
tabs.aria: role="tablist" with an aria-label; each tab is a button with role="tab", aria-selected and aria-controls; each panel has role="tabpanel", aria-labelledby and tabindex="0". Only the selected tab is in the tab order (roving tabindex).
keys: move to the previous / next tab and show its panel (wraps)
leave the tab list and move into the panel
tabs.keysShort: Left and Right arrows, Home and End; Tab moves into the panel

cards.name: Cards
cards.lede: Product cards with one link per card: the whole card is clickable, but screen readers hear a single, clear link name.
cards.aria: Each card is an <article> with a heading; the heading's link covers the card with a ::after overlay, so there is one tab stop and one link name per card. A sold-out card uses aria-disabled on its button and keeps its text readable.
keys: move from card to card (one stop each)
cards.keysShort: One Tab stop per card; Enter opens it

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.lede: Numbered pages with previous and next links, a current page and a collapsed gap for long result sets.
pagination.aria: <nav aria-label="Pagination"> around a list of links; the current page has aria-current="page"; previous on page 1 is aria-disabled and out of the tab order; the gap is hidden text, not a link. A polite live region announces the new range.
pagination.keysShort: Tab between links; Enter goes to a page

popover.name: Popover
popover.lede: A small non-modal panel anchored to a button, for a short form or details. Escape or a click outside closes it.
popover.aria: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel has role="dialog" and aria-labelledby, is not modal, and takes focus on open. Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
keys: open or close from the trigger
close and return focus to the trigger
popover.keysShort: Enter or Space opens; Escape closes and returns focus

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.lede: A short text label that appears on hover and on keyboard focus, for icon buttons and terms that need a hint.
tooltip.aria: The tooltip has role="tooltip" and the trigger points to it with aria-describedby (or aria-labelledby for an icon-only button). It shows on hover and focus, stays while hovered, and Escape hides it without moving focus.
keys: focus a trigger to show its tooltip
tooltip.keysShort: Shows on focus; Escape hides it

dropdown-menu.name: Dropdown menu
dropdown-menu.lede: An actions menu behind a button: arrow keys move through the items, Escape closes, and a disabled item is skipped.
dropdown-menu.aria: A button with aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls opens a list with role="menu"; items have role="menuitem" and tabindex="-1" (focus is moved by script); a disabled item has aria-disabled="true"; a separator has role="separator".
keys: open and focus the first item
open and focus the last item
jump to the next item starting with it
close and return focus to the button
dropdown-menu.keysShort: Arrows, Home and End, type-ahead; Escape closes

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.lede: Stacked sections that expand in place; each header is a real button inside a heading.
accordion.aria: Each header is a <button> inside an <h3> with aria-expanded and aria-controls; each panel has role="region" and aria-labelledby, and is hidden with the hidden attribute when closed.
keys: expand or collapse the focused section
accordion.keysShort: Enter or Space toggles; arrows, Home and End move

radio-group.name: Radio buttons
radio-group.lede: Choose one option from a short list, with descriptions. Native radio inputs, so the browser handles the keyboard.
radio-group.aria: A <fieldset> with a <legend> groups native <input type="radio"> controls that share a name; each has a <label> and an aria-describedby hint; a disabled option uses the disabled attribute.
keys: move into the group (to the checked option)
move and select the previous / next option
radio-group.keysShort: Arrow keys move and select; native inputs

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.lede: Where the current page sits in the site. On narrow screens the middle levels fold into a back link to the parent.
breadcrumbs.aria: <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> around an ordered list of links; the last item is the current page with aria-current="page"; separators are drawn with CSS so screen readers do not read them.

toggle-switch.name: Toggle switch
toggle-switch.lede: On and off settings that apply straight away, each with a visible label and a hint.
toggle-switch.aria: Each switch is a <button role="switch"> with aria-checked, named by its visible label (aria-labelledby) and described by its hint (aria-describedby); a disabled switch uses the disabled attribute.
keys: turn the focused switch on or off
toggle-switch.keysShort: Space or Enter flips the switch

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.lede: Progress through a short multi-step task, with completed, current and upcoming steps and Back / Next buttons.
stepper.aria: An ordered list of steps; the current step has aria-current="step"; completed and upcoming states are spelled out in visually hidden text; a polite live region announces the step on Back / Next.
keys: go back or forward one step
stepper.keysShort: Back and Next buttons; the step is announced

sidebar-nav.name: Sidebar navigation
sidebar-nav.lede: A vertical app navigation with a current page, a collapsible group and a collapse-to-icons button.
sidebar-nav.aria: <nav aria-label="Main"> with a list of links; the current page has aria-current="page"; a group header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls (disclosure pattern); the collapse button has aria-expanded and aria-controls, and icon-only links keep their text for screen readers.
keys: open or close a group, or collapse the sidebar
sidebar-nav.keysShort: Tab through links; Enter or Space opens a group

spinner.name: Loading spinner
spinner.lede: Indeterminate loading indicators in three sizes, a busy button and an inline status, with reduced-motion support.
spinner.aria: A spinner sits inside role="status" with visually hidden text ("Loading…"), so the message is announced once; a busy button is disabled with aria-busy="true" while it works. With prefers-reduced-motion the spin slows to a gentle pulse.
spinner.keysShort: No keys of its own; the busy button is announced
